title: Song of Songs and Romans
summary: Two books join the library, each translated fresh from the original languages: Song of Songs (Hebrew) and Romans (Greek). Each comes with notes on the hardest lines, the manuscript differences, who each passage was first for, and where Jews and Christians read it differently. Thirteen new topic pages cover themes from love poetry and allegory to adoption, atonement and conscience. Revelation's translation and notes were also revised.
